feedback.problem: What are the dimensions of the matrix $Y$, where $Y=[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}]?$
feedback.worked_solution: The matrix $Y$ has $1$ row  and $1$ column.  So,  its dimensions are  $1\times 1.$
